teachingItems.title: Two-variable linear equations intro
teachingItems.description: Learn about a class of equations in two variables that's called "linear equations." They are called that way because their graph is a line. These are the most basic and probably most useful equations you will ever know!

cfuMarkers.label: Explanation of why it's called a linear equation
Another example of a linear equation

teachingItems.title: Solutions to 2-variable equations
teachingItems.description: The solution of an equation with one variable is a number. How does the solution of a 2-variable equation look like? Well, it is an ordered pair. Learn more about it and how to test solutions to 2-variable equations.

teachingItems.title: Worked example: solutions to 2-variable equations
teachingItems.description: How do you check if an ordered pair is a solution to a given equation? You need to plug in the numbers and see what equality results. Watch this video to see a worked example.

teachingItems.title: Completing solutions to 2-variable equations
teachingItems.description: Given a 2-variable equation and the x or y values of a solution, Sal finds the value of the other variable in the solution.
